name: Kanto Rocks
description: ROXIE is in Kanto trying to get a band together and play one big show, and you are her manager. Recruit the members, promote the gig, then find out what happens when PIERS turns up to crash the encore. Early days: v0.1.x introduces ROXIE herself, in Vermilion City, once you have four badges. Quest System is optional -- with it installed the questline also keeps a journal entry.
